primitives.name: Java Virtual Machine Hardware Control Interface
primitives.verbatim_quote: The operating system may include, or interface with a Java virtual machine module that enables control of hardware components and/or operating system operations via Java application programs.
primitives.assumptions: Hardware abstraction layer operates through Java bytecode interpretation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when JVM cannot access native OS APIs.

layer2.mapping: JVM interface mirrors GSI's probabilistic model of device behavior under varying load conditions.
layer2.telemetry: Device capability vector derived from runtime Java app execution metrics.
